profile.intro: I'm a <highlight>full-stack developer</highlight> 🐒 from Yantai, Shandong. I'm currently building at <highlight>AMMO</highlight>, working mainly on AI agents across frontend and backend 🧱
profile.undergraduate: I studied Software Engineering at <highlight>Qufu Normal University in Jining</highlight>. While there, I served in the university's <highlight>National Flag Guard</highlight> 🇨🇳 and trained incoming students. I sometimes wish I had joined the military for the experience 😕.
profile.graduate: After graduation, I spent three years studying Artificial Intelligence at <highlight>Northeastern University in Shenyang</highlight>. I explored frontend development on my own, and years later found my way back to <highlight>AI</highlight> while expanding into backend development—the pieces finally came together 🤖
profile.hobbies: Besides coding, I enjoy playing basketball 🏀 and pool 🎱 with friends, and working out now and then 🏋 ...
profile.dream: As a child, I dreamed of becoming an astronaut 👨‍🚀. These days I focus less on one grand dream and more on a series of <highlight>small goals</highlight> 🌟
profile.career: I hope not only to write good code, but also to turn fun ideas into <highlight>products people genuinely want to use</highlight> 🚀

goal.middle: not just to build something cool ✨,
goal.suffix: but to bring fun ideas to life

timeline.codingJourney: I started with C and Java, then gradually moved to JavaScript. Frontend is fun!
timeline.graduateStudy: Studied AI, explored frontend development, practiced interview problems... and interviewed...
timeline.lab: Big Data Analytics and AI Lab @ Artificial Intelligence
timeline.reunion: No more long-distance relationship with my girlfriend! 🎉
timeline.fullStack: Moved beyond frontend into full-stack development
timeline.loveJourney: From getting together at graduation, through the years of long distance, to sharing everyday life in the same city 👫
timeline.loveOfMyLife: Finally turned the love of my youth into the love of my life ❤️
